steps: Mix the tamarind, crushed garlic and ginger, all the spices, oil and salt into a marinade.
Cut the meat into one-and-a-half-centimetre cubes and coat it in the marinade.
Refrigerate for at least four hours, ideally overnight.
Thread the pieces onto skewers packed close, without gaps.
Get the coals hot — you should not be able to hold a palm above the grate for more than three seconds.
Grill a minute and a half on each of four sides, basting with the leftover marinade.
Slide the meat off the skewers into flatbread, add raw onion and serve at once.
